meta.title: Request a Quote for Fresh Fish from Egypt
meta.description: Send your seafood requirement to AZAFCO's export team: species, size, packing, volume and destination. Quotes are confirmed per request.

hero.title: Tell us the specification. We will review supply and terms.
hero.intro: Two short steps: first what you need, then who you are. The more precise the requirement, the more useful our reply.

short_hero.corporate_intro: For partnerships, investment or other business topics. No product details needed.
short_hero.documents_intro: Ask for product specifications, certificates or the company profile. We confirm what can be shared for your request.

aside.title: What happens after you submit
steps: The export team reviews your requirement against current availability and the specification.
We contact you to confirm the details and any open points.
If we can supply, you receive a formal quotation. Price, quantity, packing and terms are confirmed in it.
aside.no_promise: Sending a request does not commit you or us to an order. Prices and availability are confirmed only in a written quotation.
prepare: Volume per shipment and how often
aside.direct_intro: Reach the export team by phone, WhatsApp or email.
aside.privacy_text: We use your details only to answer this enquiry. Please do not send confidential documents through the form.
